verdict.rationale: Official Python and TypeScript SDKs are documented: pip llama-cloud and npm @llamaindex/llama-cloud, one SDK spanning Parse, Extract, Classify, Split and Index, with a Python parse call shown. However, the Extract page lists only a Python SDK, and nothing in the evidence shows typing, job-management methods or defaults. missing for 10: evidence the SDKs are typed, confirmed TypeScript coverage of Extract, SDK-level job management (status, polling, listing), documentation of sensible defaults, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: One API key, with SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java.
Each product is a separate API on the same key and SDK.
Python: pip install llama-cloud>=1.0 ... TypeScript: npm install @llamaindex/llama-cloud
Extract is available as a web UI, Python SDK and REST API.
